needs_user: Do not retag or re-upload v0.1.0-test.2. Its Linux hashes differ from the pre-upload report because those three files were rebuilt at publish time; SHA256SUMS matches the published bytes.
Approve a new candidate (proposed v0.1.0-test.3) only if you want a release whose CI is green and whose Arch asset is the makepkg package rather than the manual layout archive.
Mi 12 / HyperOS: install the debug APK and run journeys B01–B07, including Wi-Fi toggle and sleep/wake. Notification reply and dismissal need the notification listener grant.
Arch + Hyprland: launch the AppImage from a path containing spaces; load integrations/quickshell and the Dolphin service menu; run docs/baseline-remote-input.md and record the evidence table.
DeX: with USB debugging already authorized, run journeys C01–C04. Do not expect native desktop mode on this Android 15 device.
Optional real Distrobox integration: on a machine with distrobox+podman, run scripts/build-arch-distrobox.sh and scripts/verify-arch-install.sh; the wrapper tests here are mocked.
